name: decibel-tools
description: Project intelligence for Claude — issues, decisions, roadmap, and design tracking that live in your repo.
long_description:
Decibel gives Claude a durable memory for your project. Track work as epics and issues, record architecture decisions as ADRs, capture design decisions and recurring friction, and ask what to work on next.

Privacy: everything is written as plain files inside a .decibel/ folder in the project directory you choose. Nothing is uploaded, there is no telemetry, and the files read as a normal part of your repo.

project_folder.title: Project folder
project_folder.description: The folder Decibel should track. Pick your project — Decibel sets it up automatically the first time it runs.

license_key.title: License key (optional)
license_key.description: Unlocks Pro features. Leave blank to use the free tier.
